fields.label: Finish Item
fields.description: Manual entry - pick the same Finish Item used in the Finish Item table above.

fields.label: Yarn Cost/LBS
fields.description: = sum of the Raw Materials table's Cost/LBS for rows whose Article matches this Finish Item.

fields.label: Dyeing Charges/LBS
fields.description: Type the dyeing charge per LBS.

fields.label: Weaving Charges/LBS
fields.description: Type the weaving charge per LBS.

fields.label: Wastage Total % (Dyeing + Weaving)
fields.description: = this Finish Item's Dyeing Wastage % + Weaving Wastage % (from the Finish Item table above).

fields.label: Stitching Charges/Pcs
fields.description: Type the stitching charge per piece.

fields.label: Trims Charges/Pcs
fields.description: Calculated from the Trims table: trims without a Color added up; trims with a Color averaged per Item Group (only one color is used on a piece).

fields.label: Total Cost/Pcs
fields.description: = Yarn Cost/Pcs + Dyeing/Pcs + Weaving/Pcs + Wastage Amount/Pcs + Stitching/Pcs + Cutting/Pcs + Packing/Pcs + Trims/Pcs.

fields.label: Yarn Cost/Pcs
fields.description: = sum of the Raw Materials table's Cost/Pcs for this Finish Item.

fields.label: Dyeing Charges/Pcs
fields.description: = Dyeing Charges/LBS x greige weight of one piece in LBS.

fields.label: Weaving Charges/Pcs
fields.description: = Weaving Charges/LBS x greige weight of one piece in LBS.

fields.label: Cutting Charges/Pcs
fields.description: Type the cutting charge per piece.

fields.label: Packing Charges/Pcs
fields.description: Type the packing charge per piece.
